args.title: Freight pricing (Tamarack blog + companion) — 3-bullet summary
args.body:
- Spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.

Sources: https://blog.tamarack.example/2026/freight and https://insights.tamarack.example/freight/companion
